Therefore, the drugs with antiviral activity that have an open structure of acyclonucleoside are Zidovudine and Lamivudine.

Zidovudine and lamivudine are nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, while ribavirin is a nucleoside analog but does not fit the acyclonucleoside category.
